people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God

translations.web: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of Yahweh are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”
translations.bsb: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal, and Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.”
translations.kjv: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.
translations.asv: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal; and he said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of Jehovah, but the worshippers of Baal only.
